intro: Corrahn's Dagger is the second ridge among the four mountainous fingers towering over northern Hillsbrad Foothills. This high ground serves as a hideout for rogue Syndicate operatives.

p: Rising steeply in northern Hillsbrad Foothills, Corrahn's Dagger is the second of the four rocky projections known locally as the fingers of Hillsbrad. The ridge is overrun by cutthroats belonging to the Syndicate, who use the elevated perch to overlook the valley below.
